subject: general
question:
Select the figure from among the given options that can replace the question mark (?) in the following series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/aaf86137596e35523539f3757f2968758d72de4c6343a0bb6dc54eb10493a92e.png]
solution:
The image that replace the ? in the given series is as shown below :-

 
• The middle rectangle figure which is darken below and line with arrow pointed right side horizontally rotated 90⁰ anti-clockwise → Option 2 and Option 3 are eliminated.
 
• Symbol present on left side of the middle figure moves to top right corner → Option 1 is eliminated.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f0c5859cba0d5a71dc2d8c47172061205501ad8b49ac45623910ad18dc910d40.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is** "Option 4".**
